scope: Independent bounded delegate evaluation of 0.5.1 fast-play skills; simulated, no robot

cases.prompt: Pick up the blue barrel and deliver it to the purple 0 tag
cases.source:
import json
behaviors.configure(move_mmps=150, turn_dps=45, tag_turn_dps=90, contact_mmps=200, verification="contact", timeout_ms=30000)
pickup = behaviors.collect(BLUE_BARREL)
delivery = behaviors.deliver(BLUE_BARREL, TAG0)
print(json.dumps({"pickup": pickup, "delivery": delivery}))

cases.prompt: Now orange barrel to Tag 2, then smile
cases.source:
import json
behaviors.configure(move_mmps=150, turn_dps=45, tag_turn_dps=90, contact_mmps=200, verification="contact", timeout_ms=30000)
pickup = behaviors.collect(ORANGE_BARREL)
delivery = behaviors.deliver(ORANGE_BARREL, TAG2)
robot.screen.show_emoji(Emoji.HAPPY, EmojiLook.LOOK_FORWARD)
print(json.dumps({"pickup": pickup, "delivery": delivery, "expression": "HAPPY requested"}))
